basic_info.description: Nestled in an exceptional location and on a high floor of a charming 1930s building this 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom view condo provides everything you need for a great San Francisco lifestyle. There are large windows in nearly every room that offer big views of the city, Presidio and the Golden Gate Bridge. Watch the sunrise over the city and watch the twinkle of the city lights come up in the evenings. There are even two small windows in the shower that look over the ocean! When living 1 block up from the entrance to the Presidio and a few blocks to shops and restaurants on Clement and California streets there are no shortages of pleasurable activities to enjoy.  Lands End Trail and the Legion of Honor are a short distance away as well.
